content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Traditional platforms like PayPal and Stripe provide a familiar interface and user-friendly experience for selling digital products, but they come with significant geographic restrictions. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack allows you to set up a complete online store without reliance on these platforms. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, ensuring that you can sell your ebooks without the typical barriers. Unlike PayPal or Stripe, which can freeze accounts and hold funds, your income remains accessible and under your control.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

PayPal and Stripe inherently exclude many countries, creating access barriers for creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan. They do not provide services to users from these countries, forcing many digital sellers to look for alternatives. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is built to function globally, making it possible for creators to operate without these restrictions. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you can establish a fully functional e-commerce platform that supports crypto payments, which are accessible regardless of your geographical location. This architecture ensures you're not at the mercy of the limitations imposed by conventional payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment processors often impose high transaction fees and slow payment processing times, especially for those in restricted regions. PayPal can take several days to process payments, which can disrupt cash flow. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack offers automatic on-chain payment verification through NOWPayments with a mere 0.5% fee, ensuring you receive payments quickly and at a fraction of the cost. Additionally, transactions on recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON can cost less than $0.10, making it more affordable for creators to sell their digital products without incurring excessive fees.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your online store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the critical differentiators between traditional platforms and sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership. With PayPal and Stripe, you're renting their services, and they control your data and funds. Conversely, when you deploy the Edge Commerce Stack, you gain complete ownership of your online store, including the data and customer interactions. The infrastructure is designed for automation; once set up, it allows for instant product delivery and seamless payment processing without requiring ongoing maintenance. This means you can focus on creating rather than managing the complexities of payment processing.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're a digital creator operating in a restricted country, the choice is clear: you need a sovereign commerce infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack is ideal for creators looking to sell multiple products efficiently. It provides all necessary tools and support within 48 hours of deployment. If you're starting out and only need to sell a few products, the Sovereign Starter Stack offers a cost-effective solution. In either case, the architecture allows you to bypass the restrictions of PayPal and Stripe, ensuring your ability to sell ebooks without barriers.

To sell digital products without Stripe, use sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack. This approach allows you to set up a fully functional online store using Cloudflare and NOWPayments, ensuring payments are processed quickly and securely. It provides an alternative that doesn't rely on traditional payment processors, ensuring you maintain control over your sales.
No more account freezes or fund holds—own your income.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
